samples.question: The triangle is the factual run; dark means ON. Each lower cell applies its row rule to the touching pair above. The red-ringed TOP flip alone leaves the bottom unchanged. Test one numbered switch at a time in two fresh trials. In both trials, force that cell to the opposite of its shown value and rebuild below it. Trial A keeps TOP as shown; Trial B also flips the red-ringed TOP cell. Which switch makes A and B end with different bottom rows? Answer switch-1, switch-2, switch-3, or switch-4.
